description: Machine format (wr.calls.v1, testnet): sealed per-call envelopes from the graded-calls ledger. Optional filters: state (grade_state), asset (substring of asset_or_event). Historical record only. Use calls_get for one call's full envelope once you have its call_id, calls_since to sync only what is new, and get_scoreboard instead for the human-readable track record.

asset.description: Substring match on asset_or_event, e.g. BTC.

name: calls_list
title: List Calls (Machine Format)
